title: Structural Causal Bottleneck Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.08682v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce structural causal bottleneck models (SCBMs), a novel class of structural causal models in which causal effects between high-dimensional variables are mediated by low-dimensional summary statistics, or *bottlenecks*. SCBMs provide a flexible framework for mechanism-specific, target-dependent dimension reduction while remaining estimable via standard learning algorithms. We prove that bottleneck variables are identifiable up to bijection from observational data, and validate this experimentally. We then study causal effect estimation in linear SCBMs under three standard adjustment strategies. For instrumental variables, we identify a population-level non-identifiability of na\"ive two-stage least squares when all variables are high-dimensional, and show that bottleneck representations restore identification. For mediation and backdoor adjustment, we prove that conditioning on bottleneck variables yields valid effect

translated_abstract: 我们提出了结构因果瓶颈模型（SCBMs），这是一类新颖的结构因果模型，其中高维变量之间的因果效应由低维的汇总统计量（即“瓶颈”）来传递。SCBMs为机制特定的、目标依赖的降维提供了一个灵活的框架，同时仍可通过标准学习算法进行估计。我们证明了瓶颈变量可以从观测数据中被识别（至双射），并通过实验验证了这一结论。随后，我们研究了线性SCBMs在三种标准调整策略下的因果效应估计问题。对于工具变量方法，我们发现了当所有变量均为高维时，朴素的二阶段最小二乘法在总体层面存在不可识别性，并证明瓶颈表示可以恢复可识别性。对于中介分析和后门调整，我们证明了对瓶颈变量进行条件化可以得到有效的效应估计。
tldr: 该论文提出结构因果瓶颈模型（SCBMs），用低维“瓶颈”统计量传递高维变量间的因果效应，证明了瓶颈变量在双射意义下可从观测数据识别，并表明瓶颈表示能够恢复工具变量方法的可识别性、并支持中介分析与后门调整下的有效因果效应估计。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces structural causal bottleneck models (SCBMs), in which causal effects between high-dimensional variables are mediated by low-dimensional bottlenecks, proves that bottleneck variables are identifiable up to bijection from observational data, and shows that bottleneck representations restore identification for instrumental variables and enable valid causal effect estimation under mediation and backdoor adjustment.
